newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower, declines increased late.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower, declines increased late.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower, with late commission house selling pushing contracts to session lows near the close.
Traders said the late selling appeared to be in sympathy with sharp declines in CBOT wheat futures and to Kansas City traders liquidating positions ahead of December's first notice day Friday.

Despite the 42-3/4-cent premium December has to March, traders said tight supplies of deliverable wheat may result in few delivery notices Friday. As of Nov. 22, there were 5.517 million bushels registered for delivery in Kansas City and Hutchinson versus 12.077 million a year ago in Kansas City. Hutchinson was not available as a delivery point a year ago.
Traders said trading the December/March spread was the feature early, from 39 to 43 cents premium the December.
KCBT wheat close down 7-3/4 to up four cents, with December off the six at $4.44 per bushel.
